name: Unconnected pads (floating two-terminal leg)
description: Advisory (needs a netlist): a two-terminal passive (R/C/L/D/LED/ferrite/fuse) with one leg on a net and the other on none is electrically dead. Only this unambiguous case is flagged -- net-less pads on ICs/connectors are intentional no-connects and are ignored. Not_applicable without a netlist + placement.
what_it_measures: Count of two-terminal parts with exactly one connected and one floating terminal.
